title: God Cares for you
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story you will hear 
how God sent an angel to feed 
Elijah

Today’s story includes a 
KING a QUEEN a PROPHET an ANGEL and the LORD

The queen wanted Elijah dead
Elijah wanted to be dead too
BUT 
the Lord wanted Elijah alive
SO
the Lord sent an angel to feed him and to send him to MOUNT SINAI

The angel woke Elijah up 
and Elijah found some 
HOT BREAD on coals and a jar of WATER

Elijah then got up and walked for 
40 days & 40 nights 
to the Lord’s Mountain
Mount Sinai

There he met the Lord

THE LORD CARES FOR US
AND HE DOESN’T WANT US TO GIVE UP
HE WANTS US TO FOLLOW HIM
